name: Nam Dinh
provinceNote: Clause 8 of Resolution 202/2025/QH15, passed 12 June 2025, put Hà Nam, Nam Định, and Ninh Bình into a new province named Ninh Bình, printed at 3,942.62 km² and 4,412,264 people. The 28 December 2023 plan still prints Nam Định at 1,668.8 km². VietnamPlus on 24 March 2025 prints 1,669 km² and 1,892,427 people on 1 April 2024. Those are different maps. No street border is drawn here.
dotReason: The Trần halls and the mill town are a reason to stop. The seal night is one night a year.
summary: The Trần halls and the mill town, with a pho morning that is not a karst boat. Stay when Đền Trần, Phổ Minh, and the center walk are the trip. Go to Ninh Bình when the boats are the trip, and to Hanoi when the old quarter is the point. Rail from Hà Nội is about 1 hour 40 minutes. Gate hours and tickets were not printed.
timeNeeded: A day in the center. Phủ Dầy is about 15 km southwest.
getThere: Ga Nam Định, kilometre 87. About 1 hour 40 minutes from Hà Nội on the SE cells. Road minutes are check on arrival.
seoTitle: Nam Dinh city guide — Tran halls and a pho morning
seoDescription: Stay for the Trần halls and the morning pho, not Tam Coc. Rail from Hà Nội is about 1 hour 40 minutes. Birds at Xuân Thủy run October to March.
intro: You wake in a delta city of mills and Trần halls, with the cathedral square and the lake the city page calls Hồ Vị Xuyên, and once hồ Vỵ Xuyên, at the center. The statue on quảng trường 3-2 is cast bronze, about 21 tons and 10.22 m tall, on a 6.5 m base. Stay when that center, and the seal night at Đền Trần, are the trip. Go to Ninh Bình when the karst and the boats are the trip. Go to Hanoi when the old quarter is the point. A bar street was not named. Phát Diệm’s stone church is in Kim Sơn, on the Ninh Bình side.

The morning bowl is phở bò, a small, thin, soft noodle in a clear broth the paper keeps clear with traditional fish sauce, around Chợ Rồng and phố Hàng Tiện. One article’s shop closes at 09:00. Another says a bowl can be found at any hour. Both stay. Whether that 09:00 close still holds was not rechecked. Market hours were not printed. Check on arrival. The old Hàng streets are fragments between newer houses, not a second old quarter. The 2018 page says the city had about 40 streets named Hàng. Chợ Rồng is the French-built hall one paper dates to 1922.

Phổ Minh’s tower is 19.51 m on the heritage page, with a base of 5.20 m, and 21.2 m on the 2018 city page, with a base edge of 5.21 m. Both heights stay. Đền Trần is the halls beside it. The heritage page puts the 14 Trần kings in Trùng Hoa, to the west. The tourism administration puts the 14 kings in Thiên Trường and the kings plus mandarins in Trùng Hoa. Both assignments stay. The heritage page says thôn Tức Mặc, phường Lộc Vượng, thành phố Nam Định. The 2026 plan says phường Nam Định, tỉnh Ninh Bình. The seal rite is timed at 22:00 on the tourism page, and the 2026 plan runs the yard from 21:00 to 23:10. Both clocks stay. A ticket was not printed. Check on arrival.

Phủ Dầy is about 15 km southwest, the Mother Goddess complex UNESCO inscribed in 2016. Chùa Cổ Lễ is about 15 km out đường 21. The tourism page says that tower is 12 storeys, built 1926–1927, with 60 steps, and a bell of 9 tons and 3.2 m cast in 1936. Vietnamnet says 32 m, 9 storeys, built 1927, 64 steps. Vietnam.vn repeats 32 m and 9 storeys and prints the bell at about 4.2 m. Both storey counts stay. The town is thị trấn Cổ Lễ, huyện Trực Ninh, tỉnh Nam Định on the tourism page, and xã Cổ Lễ, tỉnh Ninh Bình on Vietnam.vn. Xuân Thủy’s Ramsar year is 1989 in the park page body and 1988 in a sister title. Both years stay. Nhà thờ Lớn, at số 16 phố Hai Bà Trưng, was blessed in 1895. One listing dates the damage to 1968 and the repair to 1973. Another dates the bomb damage to 1946 and the repair to 1973. Both years stay. Gate hours and tickets for these sights were not printed. Check on arrival.
gettingAround: No passenger airport is named in the 2023 planning decision. The usual previous stop is Hà Nội. A block time from Nội Bài is check on arrival. Ga Nam Định is kilometre 87 on the southbound Hà Nội–Sài Gòn table. The station street was not printed. Fares were not on the table. Check on arrival. Southbound SE cells: SE7 Hà Nội 06:00 and Nam Định 07:40, SE5 08:00 and 09:40, SE9 13:00 and 14:41, SE3 19:20 and 21:00, SE1 21:45 and 23:26. The cell differences are 1 hour 40 minutes or 1 hour 41 minutes. Northbound cells run from 1 hour 40 minutes to 1 hour 44 minutes. SE7 puts Ninh Bình 36 minutes after Nam Định, 07:40 to 08:16. The “ngày +” marks on the northbound table are counted from Sài Gòn. A day-of-week note was not on the page. A second timetable was not opened.

The 2018 city page prints both khoảng 80 km and hơn 100 km for this city from Hà Nội, and chừng 150 km for Thịnh Long from Hà Nội. Those stay beside the rail kilometre of 87. None is chosen. Drive minutes and a toll are check on arrival. A bus station name was not on the pages opened. Check on arrival. The planning decision names quốc lộ 10 toward Cao Bồ and Ninh Bình, quốc lộ 21 through Cổ Lễ and Xuân Trường to Quất Lâm, and cao tốc CT.08 as Ninh Bình – Nam Định – Thái Bình – Hải Phòng. Kilometres of those expressways were not in the paragraphs opened. Check on arrival.

In the center, the cathedral, Chợ Rồng, and the Hàng streets are a walk. A minute from the cathedral to Đền Trần was not printed. Check on arrival. The coastal districts’ shore is printed as 72 km. That is not the length of one beach. Quất Lâm is the Giao Thủy beach the city page names for summer and weekends. Thịnh Long is more than 3 km of fine sand by đường 21. Rạng Đông is named with them as a beach zone, and its length was not printed. Do not borrow Thịnh Long’s 3 km for Rạng Đông. The 2023 plan’s border sentence is north Thái Bình, south Ninh Bình, west and northwest Hà Nam, east the gulf. VietnamPlus prints northeast Thái Bình, southwest Ninh Bình, northwest Hà Nam, southeast the gulf. Both wordings stay.

stayAreas.name: Center
stayAreas.summary: Sleep around the cathedral, Chợ Rồng, and the lake when the halls and the pho morning are the point. Rooms on the sand at Quất Lâm, Thịnh Long, or Rạng Đông are the other night. No hotel brand is a pick. The city office at số 10 Trần Đăng Ninh is not a stay.

eat: Breakfast is phở bò around Chợ Rồng and phố Hàng Tiện: a small, thin, soft noodle and a clear broth. One paper describes áp chảo and sốt vang at a shop, and a broth of pork and beef bones. That paper’s shop closes at 09:00. Another says a bowl can be found at any hour. Both stay. Bánh cuốn làng Kênh, thin rice sheets with wood-ear, fried shallot, a slice of chả, and a fish-sauce dip, is the other morning, in phường Lộc Vượng, often off a banana leaf. No stall price is printed.

Afternoon is bánh xíu páo, a small baked bun with diced xá xíu, fat, wood-ear, and half a boiled quail egg, on Lê Hồng Phong, Trần Hưng Đạo, Hàng Sắt, Bắc Ninh, and Lý Thường Kiệt. Xôi xíu sits with the street snacks on phố Bắc Ninh. Bún đũa, a thick white noodle in a crab riêu, is placed at Chợ Ngõ Ngang, Chợ Rồng, or phố Hàng Đồng. A meal time for it was not printed. Check on arrival. Gifts named to carry are kẹo Sìu Châu, bánh gai, bánh nhãn Hải Hậu, chuối ngự, and gạo tám. Nem nắm and the spelling nem mắm both stay for the fermented pork of Giao Thủy, and of Hải Hậu on the city page. A wrapping was not printed. Check on arrival.
interestsBody: The Trần ground is Đền Trần and chùa Phổ Minh. The tower heights disagree, and both stay: 19.51 m and 21.2 m.
Phủ Dầy is the Mother Goddess complex, about 15 km southwest. The city churches are Nhà thờ Lớn, Phú Nhai, and Bùi Chu. Phát Diệm is in Kim Sơn.
The coast the plan names is Quất Lâm, Thịnh Long, and Rạng Đông. Xuân Thủy is mangrove and birds, October to March, with Ramsar years 1988 and 1989 both printed.

interestGroups.title: The Tran halls
interestGroups.summary: For the second-capital ground at Tức Mặc, the tower, and the seal night.
body: Walk Phổ Minh and the three halls beside it. Thiên Trường sits in the middle on the heritage page. Cố Trạch, to the east, is Trần Hưng Đạo. Trùng Hoa, to the west, is the 14 Trần kings on that page. The tourism administration instead says Thiên Trường is the 14 kings and Trùng Hoa is the kings plus civil and military mandarins. Both assignments stay. The yard has a five-door gate and a lake of about 1,000 m². VietnamPlus calls this ground the second capital, Thiên Trường.

The seal rite is the 14th–15th of lunar month 1. The tourism page times the opening at 22:00 on the 14th. For Xuân Bính Ngọ the ward plan prints 27 February–4 March 2026, and on the night of 2 March guests leave the yard from 21:00, incense runs 22:15–22:40, and the seal palanquin 22:40–23:10. Both clocks stay. The next solar date after 2026 is check on arrival. A second festival in lunar month 8 marks the death anniversary of Trần Hưng Đạo. A day number inside that month was not printed. Check on arrival. No ticket was printed.

The tower is 14 storeys on both pages. Height is 19.51 m on the heritage page and 21.2 m on the 2018 city page. The base is 5.20 m and 5.21 m. Both stay. The front hall is 9 bays, 24.93 m by 8.22 m. The textile house at số 5 Hoàng Hoa Thám was the French mill manager’s lodging, refitted for display in 2010. Floor 1 is the machines. Floor 2 is the French period, the wars, and the later industry. A visitor hour was not printed. Check on arrival. The flag tower on đường Tô Hiệu was finished in Quý Mão (1843). The page names it as one of four, with Huế (1807), Hà Nội (1812), and Bắc Ninh (1838). A gate hour was not printed.

cards.title: Pho Minh pagoda
cards.summary: The stone tower. 19.51 m on the heritage page and 21.2 m on the 2018 city page.

interestGroups.title: The Mother Goddess ground
interestGroups.summary: For Phủ Dầy, the festival UNESCO names, about 15 km southwest of the city.
body: Phủ Tiên Hương is nearly 7,500 m², 19 buildings, 81 bays. Phủ Vân Cát is about 1 km east, nearly 3,600 m². UNESCO’s 2016 listing names Phủ Dầy as a festival of the Mother Goddesses of the Three Realms, and names Liễu Hạnh the Mother of the World. Ranked a national relic by Decision 09-VH/QĐ of 21 February 1975. Nearly 20 sites on one account, centered on Phủ Tiên Hương, Phủ Vân Cát, and the mausoleum.

The ministry prints the festival at the start of lunar month 3. One article’s solar window was 9–14 April, mapped to the 3rd–8th of that lunar month, and those solar days are not said to repeat. The next solar date is check on arrival. What happens includes processions, a torch procession at Phủ Tiên Hương, chầu văn, and human chess. A gate hour and a ticket were not printed. The Viềng spring fair is named at huyện Vụ Bản without one agreed day. Check on arrival.

cards.title: Phu Day
cards.summary: The phủ court about 15 km southwest. The lunar month 3 dates move. Check on arrival.

interestGroups.title: The church square
interestGroups.summary: For Nhà thờ Lớn in the center, and the Xuân Trường churches at Phú Nhai and Bùi Chu.
body: Nhà thờ Lớn faces phố Trần Hưng Đạo at bến Đò Quan. The parish listing puts it at số 16 phố Hai Bà Trưng. It was blessed in 1895. That listing dates the damage to 1968 and the repair to 1973. Another page dates the bomb damage to 1946 and the repair to 1973. Both years stay. Mass clocks on the parish listing: weekdays 05:00 and 18:30, Saturday the same, Sunday 05:30, 08:00, 17:00, 18:30, and 20:00. A square fee was not printed. Check on arrival. It is the parish of the Hanoi archdiocese, not the Bùi Chu cathedral.

Phú Nhai is at xã Xuân Phương, huyện Xuân Trường, more than 1 km from the town, and the city page calls it one of the widest churches in the country. A height and a mass hour were not printed. Bùi Chu, at xã Xuân Ngọc, is dated from 1885 and printed at 78 m long, 22 m wide, and 15 m high. A mass hour was not printed. Check on arrival. Chùa Cổ Lễ, about 15 km out đường 21, is 12 storeys on the tourism page and 9 storeys on Vietnamnet and Vietnam.vn. Both stay, with the bell at 3.2 m and about 4.2 m.

cards.title: Phu Nhai basilica
cards.summary: The gray facade and the front court in Xuân Trường. A mass hour was not printed.

faqs.q: Is Nam Dinh the same trip as Ninh Binh or Tam Coc?
faqs.a: No. The karst, the boats, and Hoa Lư are the Ninh Bình page, and Tam Cốc is the boat page beyond Ninh Bình station. This city is the textile town and the Trần halls. Clause 8 put the old Nam Định province into the new Ninh Bình province, printed at 3,942.62 km² and 4,412,264 people. The 2023 plan still prints 1,668.8 km², and VietnamPlus prints 1,669 km². Those figures are not the size of the city you sleep in.

faqs.q: How long is the train from Hanoi to Nam Dinh?
faqs.a: On the one railway table, southbound SE cells differ by 1 hour 40 minutes or 1 hour 41 minutes, and Nam Định is kilometre 87. SE7 is Hà Nội 06:00 and Nam Định 07:40. Fares were not on the table. The 2018 city page also prints khoảng 80 km and hơn 100 km for the same city. Road minutes are check on arrival.

faqs.q: When is the seal rite at the Tran temple, and what does it cost?
faqs.a: The tourism page prints the 14th–15th of lunar month 1 and times the rite at 22:00 on the 14th. The 2026 plan used a later clock that night, 21:00 to 23:10, on 2 March. Both stay. The next solar date is check on arrival. No ticket was printed on the pages opened. Check on arrival.

season.label: Birds Oct–Mar
season.note: Route 3 at Xuân Thủy prints October to March for birding in the mangroves at cửa Ba Lạt. The park page body prints the Ramsar year 1989, the 50th site and the first in Southeast Asia. A sister page on the same portal is titled 1988. Both years stay. The city page ties Quất Lâm and Thịnh Long to summer and weekends. A swim-season rule and a storm rule for the coast were not printed. The seal rite is the 14th of lunar month 1. The 2026 solar night was 2 March. The next solar date, the day inside lunar month 8, and the Viềng day are check on arrival.
